recipes.name: Banana Cream Pie with Pudding
ingredients_raw: 2 (3.5 ounce) packages instant vanilla pudding mix
2 cups frozen whipped topping, thawed, divided

steps.text: Slice two bananas; arrange banana slices in a single layer to cover bottom of pie crust.
Pour cold milk into a medium bowl. Add pudding mix and whisk until thoroughly combined. Fold in 1/2 cup whipped topping.
Pour into crust over bananas. Refrigerate until firm, at least 3 hours.
When ready to serve, spread remaining whipped topping over pie. Slice remaining banana and arrange over topping.

raw_recipe.headline: Banana Cream Pie with Pudding
raw_recipe.description: Try this easy banana cream pie recipe with pudding for a delicious pie with no stirring over the stove. Old-fashioned taste with time-saving ingredients.

review.reviewBody: My niece said, "this is better than Marie Calendars." Everyone loved this pie. I added 1/2 of a small banana to the pudding mixture for flavor (not the whole banana, because you don't want to "over-kill" the flavor). It was perfect! I used the small 1 ounce boxes of pudding and it was a perfect amount for one pie. I think because I used the marie calendar pie pans and they are smaller than 9 inches. I noticed that a some people had extra pudding and I think it's because it depends on the size of the pie pan used. Ok for member SENORITA132, you said the pie was too watery... the recipe says to "whisk" the pudding, but I would suggest using a mixer and beat it until it's nice and thick. It worked for me this way rather than using a whisk. Also, thank you to BAVERDUCE for your suggestion about dipping the bananas in lemon juice so that they don't brown. It really works!

Excellent pie, very easy. I took the advice of some previous reviewers and used banana and french vanilla pudding mixes. DEFINATELY go with a ready-made crust like graham cracker, vanilla wafer or chocolate.

Thank you for sharing this great recipe! This was my first time making banana cream pie and this was pretty easy to follow the directions and it tasted even better than some we've gotten from the store. I did read many of the reviews and followed some of their suggestions. Like a previous reviewer had mentioned, make sure you are using INSTANT pudding mix and NOT the cook & serve pudding mix. I'm glad I read that review and realized I was about to use the wrong one! Like some reviewers mentioned, I also opted to use 1 box instant vanilla pudding & 1 box instant banana pudding. I followed the directions in this recipe instead of following those on the pudding box. I also used the electric mixer to beat the pudding instead of a wisk. I also followed a reviewers suggestion to dip the banana slices in lemon juice and blot dry with a paper towel so that they wont turn brown. Great idea - Thank you! I lined the bottom of the cooled pie crust (i used a store bought pie crust) with the banana slices and also folded in slices of 1 small banana into the pudding mixture to add real banana inside the pie. On top of the cool whip topping, i sliced the last banana (also dipped in lemon juice & blotted dry with a paper towel) and added slivered almonds. Everyone LOVED it! So good! Thank you!!

I used banana pudding you cook using 1 3/4 cups milk, then cool using plastic wrap over pudding to prevent skin. When cool mix half container of cool whip with pudding and put in graham wafer crust (1 1/2 c graham crumbs, 1/4 c sugar, 1/4 c melted margarine pressed into 9" pan baked at 375F for 8 min and cooled) lined with sliced bananas (save a few Tablespoons of graham mixture to sprinkle on top at end). Chill min 3 hours, then slice another banana on top and cover with rest of cool whip.
I love this recipe, so easy. But I actually add a whole ripe banana into the pudding mix once it thickens a bit, then I fold in the whipped topping. It gives the pie a better banana flavour. Yummy

JELLO changed the # of ounces in the package of pudding. That’s why people are having trouble with it not setting up. have this recipe from 35 or more years. Only the instructions a little difference. The first step was a thin layer of the pudding in the very bottom, then the bananas, then a layer of the mixed pudding and Cool Whip, then layer of Cool Whip. It was in a pamphlet From Jello. They messed up their own recipes by making the change.

This was so good and devoured immediately before any of the other pies at Thanksgiving this year! I made the graham cracker crust by pulsing 12 reduced-fat graham cracker (sheets), 5 Tbls melted butter, 1/4 cup sugar, and 1/8 tsp salt into a fine sand. I sliced up 2 1/2 bananas and placed them on the crust. I diced up the remaining 1/2 banana and mixed it into the pudding (to prevent browning). I made homemade whipped cream with 2 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream, 2 1/2 teaspoons vanilla, and 3 Tbls powdered sugar and pipped a rose pattern over the entire pie. SO GOOD!! UPDATE: the grocery store was out of regular graham crackers so I bought a box of already crushed crackers. I used 1 1/2 cups and 7 tablespoons butter.

I used the mini graham cracker pie crusts for a no mess individual serve. Then used a piping bag for whipped topping to decorate and sprinkled with crushed mini nilla wafers...one for garnish on top. Looked and tasted delicious!
It's not only easy as pie but delicious. My family loves it. I added 1/2 teaspoon vanilla to the mixture and I used a graham cracker crust.
I found it to be very good I used 1 box of vanilla and 1 box of banana pudding and 1 1/2 cups of milk and my family loved it !!! Making it again now. A great dessert!!!

I made it for my nieces little birthday party and everyone loved it, even the kids! Many asked me for the recipe which I was glad to share, it is absolutely perfect. I mixed in a banana with the vanilla pudding mix and also mixed the sliced bananas with a little bit of lemon juice just to avoid browning.
It was great and super easy. 👍
Simple and easy. Used a derp dish pie crust so it would all fit in!
This recipe is like the original. Finally tastes as it should. This crust must be pre baked.. totally a must try . Very fluffy recipe. Loved it.
So simple. I even used a pre-made graham cracker crust (brushed with egg, 375F for 5 min) for a pretty crust. Perfectly thick custard, came out nicely. Followed directions exactly.

The recipe was simple and easy to follow. Instead of vanilla pudding I used banana cream & cheesecake flavored pudding and it was so much better than the plain ol’ vanilla pudding. Definitely recommend and don’t be afraid to tweak the recipe to your liking or dietary needs. For example we are a sugar free family so I used zero sugar everything.
